verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a public REST API for automating account data from the my.anydesk console. It can list and inspect clients, retrieve session history, close active sessions, edit aliases and comments, list address books, and output system stats, and it ships an open-source Python module. That scope covers account and session administration rather than the remote-control session itself, which is reachable only through CLI parameters, and the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: API control of the remote session itself (starting connections, input or screen actions), a published OpenAPI/Swagger specification, documentation of API authentication and depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
